data.name: Skilled Liar
data.description: Whenever a spy uses Bluff to attempt to deceive someone, she gains a +%1 bonus on the opposed roll. This bonus does not apply to feint attempts or attempts to pass secret messages. This ability replaces trapfinding.|max(RogueLVL/2,1)
